apps.name: What Is This?
apps.description: Point your camera at a plant, animal, object, dish or landmark and your AI tells you what it is, with fun facts and a useful tip.
apps.prompt: A camera app that identifies whatever you point it at using the AI: name, kind, confidence, a short description, surprising facts, a practical tip and a warning when something is toxic or dangerous. It can read the answer aloud, tell you more, and keeps a gallery of your discoveries.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: What Can I Do?
apps.description: Point your camera at anything and your AI suggests things to make, cook, fix or play with it.
apps.prompt: A camera app: I point it at anything, take a photo and my AI suggests five ideas of what to do with it, with steps, and I can choose a focus like cooking, crafts, fixing or games for kids.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Stack Tower 3D
apps.description: Stack sliding blocks as high as you can: overhangs are cut off and tumble down, perfect drops grow your tower.
apps.prompt: A 3D stacking game with three.js: blocks slide in from alternating sides, I tap to drop them, the part that overhangs is cut and falls, perfect drops give combos and grow the block back, rainbow colours and a camera that rises with the tower.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Solar System
apps.description: Watch the planets orbit the Sun, pinch to zoom and tap any planet for its size, year, day, moons, temperature and a fun fact.
apps.prompt: An animated solar system: the eight planets orbiting the Sun with a speed control, pinch and drag to explore, and a sheet for each planet and the Sun with distance, year length, day length, moons, diameter, temperature and a fun fact.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Periodic Table
apps.description: All 118 elements in a colourful table. Tap one to see its symbol, mass, group and what it's used for, or filter by family.
apps.prompt: An interactive periodic table with all 118 elements coloured by family, a legend that filters by family, search by name or symbol, and a detail sheet with atomic number, mass, group, period and a short note on each element.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Neon Drift 3D
apps.description: Race down a synthwave highway at sunset: drag to dodge neon barriers and grab glowing orbs.
apps.prompt: A 3D endless racer with three.js in a synthwave style: a neon grid highway, a striped sunset sun, wireframe mountains, a glowing car I steer by dragging, neon barriers to dodge, orbs to collect and speed that keeps rising.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: First Aid
apps.description: What to do in an emergency, step by step and offline: CPR with a rhythm guide, choking, bleeding, burns, stroke and more.
apps.prompt: An offline first aid guide with a big emergency call button and the number for your region, step-by-step cards for CPR with a 110 bpm metronome, choking, heavy bleeding, stroke, severe allergy, seizures, burns, fainting, heatstroke, nosebleeds, sprains and poisoning, each with what not to do.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Castle Siege 3D
apps.description: Defend your castle wall: enemies march up the valley towards you and you shoot them down with your crossbow.
apps.prompt: A 3D castle defence game with three.js where I stand on the castle wall looking down a valley, soldiers, goblins, knights, ogres and bosses march towards me along the road, I tap to shoot crossbow bolts, and between waves I buy upgrades like more damage, faster reload, multiple bolts, fire bolts and wall repairs.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Would You Rather
apps.description: Party, silly and deep dilemmas: everyone taps their choice and you reveal how the group split.
apps.prompt: A Would You Rather party game with three decks of questions, two big colourful halves to tap, a vote counter so the whole group can vote and a reveal with percentages.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: World Flags
apps.description: Guess the country from its flag, by continent or the whole world. Rounds of 10 with streaks and a list of the ones to review.
apps.prompt: A flags quiz: pick a continent or the whole world, see a big flag and choose the country among four options from the same region, with streaks, best scores per region and a list of the flags you missed.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: World Clock
apps.description: Your cities at a glance with day and night icons, a slider to shift the time, and a planner that finds hours that work for everyone.
apps.prompt: A world clock: add cities from a list, see their time, day and difference from mine with a sun or moon icon, a slider to move the time forward or back, and a meeting planner grid that highlights the hours that are working hours everywhere.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Wind and Waves
apps.description: Wind, gusts, waves, swell and water temperature for any beach, with a 3-day chart that rates each hour for surfing and sailing.
apps.prompt: A wind and waves app for surfers and sailors using the free Open-Meteo forecast and marine APIs with no key. Search a beach or use my location. Show wind speed, gusts and direction with an animated compass arrow, wave height, wave period and swell direction, water temperature, and a 3 day hourly chart. Rate each hour as good, fair or poor for surfing and for sailing with colours.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Will It Rain
apps.description: Find out at a glance whether you need an umbrella today, with the chance of rain hour by hour and the next 7 days.
apps.prompt: A weather app that answers one question: will it rain today and in the next hours. Use the free Open-Meteo API with no key, ask for the location or let me search a city, show a big friendly answer with an umbrella or sun, the chance of rain hour by hour as a chart for the next 24 hours, and the next 7 days. Texts in Spanish if the phone is in Spanish, otherwise in English. Save my last city.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Weather Now
apps.description: Current weather, the next 24 hours and 7 days for your city, with an animated sky that follows the weather.
apps.prompt: A beautiful weather app using the free Open-Meteo API with no key. Use my location or let me search a city and save it. Show the current temperature big, feels like, wind, humidity and an animated background that changes with the weather and day or night, a swipeable hourly forecast for 24 hours and the next 7 days with highs and lows. Texts in Spanish if the phone is in Spanish, otherwise in English.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Unit Converter
apps.description: Convert length, weight, temperature, volume, speed, area, data, time and fuel consumption instantly.
apps.prompt: A clean unit converter with categories for length, weight, temperature, volume, speed, area, data, time and fuel consumption, a swap button and every other unit listed below.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: UV Index
apps.description: Today's UV index as a colourful gauge, the hourly curve, the peak hour and how long until you burn for your skin type.
apps.prompt: A UV index app with the free Open-Meteo API and no key. Use my location or a searched city. Show today's UV index as a big colourful gauge, the hourly UV curve for today, the peak hour, when it is safe to be in the sun, and advice for sunscreen, hat and sunglasses for each level. Add a skin type picker to estimate minutes until sunburn. Tomorrow's max UV too.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Truth or Dare
apps.description: Add the players, pick a level from kids to bold, and let the phone choose truths and dares.
apps.prompt: A Truth or Dare game for groups: add players, choose kids, friends or bold level, it picks whose turn it is and shows a truth or a dare card, all fun and friendly.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Trivia Night
apps.description: Ten quick questions on geography, science, history, movies, sports or animals, with streaks and a 50:50.
apps.prompt: A trivia quiz with built-in questions in English and Spanish about geography, science, history, movies and music, sports and animals, ten questions per round with a 15 second timer, streak bonus, 50:50 and best score per topic.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Torch & SOS
apps.description: Turn on your phone's flashlight, send SOS in Morse code, use a strobe or light up the screen.
apps.prompt: A flashlight app that uses my phone's real torch through Acornix, with a big power button, SOS in Morse code, an adjustable strobe and a coloured screen light.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Times Tables
apps.description: Pick the tables you want and practise them at your pace or race against 60 seconds. Stars for every table you master.
apps.prompt: A times tables trainer for kids: pick which tables to practise, a big number keypad, a relaxed practice mode of 20 questions and a 60-second race with a high score. Mistakes come back later, and each table earns up to three stars.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Timer & Stopwatch
apps.description: A precise stopwatch with laps and a countdown timer with presets, alarm and notification.
apps.prompt: A stopwatch with laps that marks the fastest and slowest, and a countdown timer with quick presets, a ring that empties, an alarm sound, vibration and a notification when time is up.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Time Tracker
apps.description: Track the hours you spend on each project and client, with hourly rates and a report to share.
apps.prompt: A time tracker with a big start and stop button, projects with hourly rates, what I'm working on, totals for today, this week, this month or all time with the money earned, a log and a report to share.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Tasks
apps.description: A clear to-do list with lists, priorities, due dates and overdue tasks grouped at the top.
apps.prompt: A to-do app with personal, work and shopping lists, three priority colours, due dates, tasks grouped by overdue, today, upcoming and no date, a progress bar and done tasks crossed out.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Task Breaker
apps.description: Overwhelmed by a big task? Your AI breaks it into small steps with time estimates.
apps.prompt: An app for overwhelming tasks: I write a big task and my AI breaks it into small concrete steps with minutes for each, I tick them off with a progress bar, and any step can be split again into smaller steps.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Symbols
apps.description: Arrows, maths, currencies, accents, Greek letters, ticks and more. Tap to build a string, long-press to copy one.
apps.prompt: A special characters picker with categories for arrows, maths, money, punctuation, accented letters, Greek, legal and tech, shapes, ticks, music and zodiac, box drawing and superscripts, search by name in English or Spanish, recent symbols and a tray to build and copy text.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Sun and Moon
apps.description: Sunrise, sunset, golden and blue hour with the sun moving along today's arc, plus the moon phase and the next full moon.
apps.prompt: A sun and moon app using the free Open-Meteo API with no key for sunrise and sunset, with my location or a searched city. Draw today's sun path as an arc with the sun moving along it in real time, show sunrise, sunset, day length, golden hour and blue hour for photographers, and how many minutes the day grows or shrinks. Calculate the moon phase locally and draw it, with the next full moon and new moon dates.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Sudoku
apps.description: Endless Sudoku puzzles with one solution, four levels, notes, hints and undo.
apps.prompt: A Sudoku game that generates new puzzles with a single solution in four difficulty levels, with pencil notes, hints, undo, mistakes counter, timer and the game saved.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Subscriptions
apps.description: All your subscriptions in one place: what they cost per month and year, and when the next payment is.
apps.prompt: A subscriptions tracker with quick buttons for Netflix, Spotify and others, price and billing cycle, the total per month, year and day, upcoming payments with warnings for the next days and a tip on what you'd save.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Story Adventure
apps.description: Your AI narrates an adventure where you choose what happens: fantasy, space, pirates and more.
apps.prompt: An interactive story game where my AI is the narrator: I choose a world like fantasy, space or pirates, name my hero, and each turn it writes the story with three choices or I type my own action, with health and inventory, saved to continue later.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Stock Counter
apps.description: Count your stock with big plus and minus buttons and get warned when something is running low.
apps.prompt: An inventory counter for a small shop with products, emoji, big plus and minus buttons that repeat when held, a minimum for each product, low stock warnings at the top and a restock list to share.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Star Defender
apps.description: A neon space shooter: drag your ship, blast waves of enemies, collect upgrades and beat the bosses.
apps.prompt: A vertical space shooter with a ship I drag, auto fire, enemy types that zigzag, shoot or take many hits, waves, a boss every five waves, shield and weapon upgrades and a best score.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Split the Bill
apps.description: Split a bill evenly with tip and rounding, or work out who owes whom after a trip.
apps.prompt: A bill splitter with two modes: split evenly with people, tip and rounding up, or enter how much each person paid and it tells who pays whom to settle up, with a share button.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Spelling Bee
apps.description: Hear a word and spell it with the bee keyboard. Three levels in English or Spanish, clues, slow mode and three lives.
apps.prompt: A spelling bee game: the phone says a word out loud and you spell it with a big on-screen keyboard, in English or Spanish, three levels of difficulty, a slow mode that spells it letter by letter, clues, three lives and stars per level.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Solitaire
apps.description: Classic Klondike solitaire made for touch: tap a card and it jumps where it fits.
apps.prompt: Klondike solitaire for phones where tapping a card moves it to the best place, with draw one or draw three, undo, hints, auto-finish, a win animation and the game saved.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Snap Translate
apps.description: Take a photo of a sign, menu or label and your AI translates it into your language, with notes.
apps.prompt: A camera translator: I frame any text like a sign, a menu or instructions, take a photo and my AI reads it and translates it into the language I choose, keeping the layout, with cultural notes, listen and copy buttons, and I can also type text.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Sky Hopper
apps.description: Tap to flap a little bird through the pipes, earn medals and beat your best score.
apps.prompt: A Flappy Bird style game with a cute bird drawn in code, tap to flap, moving pipes later on, medals, sounds, parallax clouds and hills and a saved best score.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Sell It
apps.description: Snap what you want to sell and your AI writes the listing, picks keywords and suggests a fair price.
apps.prompt: A second-hand selling helper: I take up to four photos of something I want to sell, add details, choose a style, and my AI writes the title and description, suggests a price range, the condition, the category and keywords, ready to copy.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Savings Goals
apps.description: Fill piggy bank jars for each goal and see how much to save each month to get there in time.
apps.prompt: A savings goals app with a jar that fills up for each goal, target and deadline, quick buttons to add money, how much to save per month and per week to reach it, and confetti when a goal is reached.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Sales Pipeline
apps.description: Follow your deals from first contact to won, with a funnel, a forecast and next steps.
apps.prompt: A simple sales CRM with deals, client, value, next step date, contact and notes, stages from lead to won or lost, a funnel chart, open value, a weighted forecast and overdue follow-ups in red.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Routine Runner
apps.description: Run your morning and evening routines step by step with a timer and a voice that guides you.
apps.prompt: A routine runner with morning and evening routines made of timed steps I can edit, a full screen mode that counts down each step, says the next step out loud, vibrates and celebrates at the end.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Roman Numerals
apps.description: Convert numbers to Roman numerals and back, see how each one is built, and learn the three rules to read them.
apps.prompt: A Roman numerals converter that works both ways for 1 to 3999, shows how the number breaks down symbol by symbol, warns about invalid numerals, and has the seven symbols, examples to try and the rules for reading them.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Receipt Scanner
apps.description: Snap a receipt and your AI notes the shop, the items, the total and the category.
apps.prompt: A receipt scanner: I take a photo of a shopping receipt and my AI reads the shop, date, every item with its price, the total and a category, saves it, adds up the month and exports everything to CSV.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Random Picker
apps.description: Roll dice, flip a coin, pick a number or choose from your own list. Shake to roll.
apps.prompt: A random picker with four modes: up to five dice with total, a flipping coin, a random number in a range without repeats, and picking from my own list, with shake to roll.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Quiz Me
apps.description: Tell it what you're studying, or paste your notes, and your AI makes a multiple-choice quiz with an explanation for every answer.
apps.prompt: A quiz generator: type a topic or paste your notes, choose the level and number of questions, and the AI creates a multiple-choice quiz. After each answer show whether it was right and why, and at the end a score ring and a list of past quizzes.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Priority Matrix
apps.description: Sort your tasks by urgent and important: do, schedule, delegate or drop them.
apps.prompt: An Eisenhower priority matrix with four coloured quadrants, do it now, schedule it, delegate it and drop it, where I add tasks to a quadrant and tap a task to complete, move or delete it.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Pocket Dictionary
apps.description: Look up any word in English or Spanish with your AI: meanings, examples, pronunciation, synonyms, a translation and where it comes from.
apps.prompt: A dictionary powered by the AI: look up a word in English, Spanish or translate between them, with IPA pronunciation, parts of speech, definitions with examples, synonyms and opposites you can tap, translation and origin, a speak button, a word of the day and recent words.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Pitch Writer
apps.description: Your AI turns your idea into a memorable elevator pitch, with a teleprompter to rehearse it.
apps.prompt: An elevator pitch writer: I describe my idea, the audience, the length and the style, and my AI writes a pitch with a tagline and three key points, which I can listen to, copy, or rehearse with a scrolling teleprompter and timer.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Number Bases
apps.description: Convert between decimal, binary, hexadecimal and octal as you type, and flip bits with a tap to see what changes.
apps.prompt: A number base converter: decimal, binary, hexadecimal and octal fields that update each other as you type, tappable bits, shift, NOT and +1 buttons, and the number shown as a character, a colour and a signed 16-bit value.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Noise Meter
apps.description: Measure how loud it is around you with a gauge, min, average, max and a live chart.
apps.prompt: A sound level meter using the microphone that shows approximate decibels on a gauge with a needle, a label like library or traffic, min, average and max, and a live chart.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Net Worth
apps.description: Add up what you own and what you owe, and save a monthly snapshot to see your net worth grow.
apps.prompt: A net worth tracker with a list of assets and a list of debts I can edit, my net worth, and a monthly snapshot button that draws a line chart and keeps a history.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Neon Snake
apps.description: The classic snake in glowing neon: swipe to turn, eat the lights and chase bonus orbs.
apps.prompt: A neon snake game with swipe controls and arrow buttons, glowing food, pink bonus orbs that disappear, walls or wrap-around mode, three speeds and a saved best score.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Morse Code
apps.description: Translate text to Morse and back, play it as sound, flashlight or vibration, and tap your own code on a straight key.
apps.prompt: A Morse code app: translate text to Morse and Morse to text, play it as a beep, with the flashlight or with vibration at an adjustable speed, a big straight key that decodes what you tap, and a chart of every letter and number.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Minesweeper
apps.description: Clear the field without hitting a mine: three sizes, long-press to flag and best times.
apps.prompt: A Minesweeper game made for touch: tap to dig, long-press or a flag mode to place flags, chording on numbers, three board sizes, a timer and best times per level.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Memory Match
apps.description: Flip the cards and find all the pairs: four board sizes, four themes and star ratings.
apps.prompt: A memory card game with 3D flipping cards, emoji themes like animals, food, sports and space, four board sizes, moves and time, star rating, confetti and best scores.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Math Sprint
apps.description: 60 seconds of mental maths. Answer fast to chain combos and multiply your points, in three levels from sums to brackets.
apps.prompt: A fast mental maths game: 60 seconds, four answer buttons, three levels from addition and subtraction to all four operations and brackets, combo multipliers for answers in a row, time penalty for mistakes and a best score per level.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Margin & Markup
apps.description: Work out the right selling price, your real margin or the most you can pay, including tax.
apps.prompt: A pricing calculator with three modes: the selling price for a target margin, the margin from cost and price, and the maximum cost for a price and margin, with markup, profit, price with tax and a breakdown bar.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Magnifier
apps.description: Zoom in on small print with your camera, freeze the image, turn on the light and boost contrast.
apps.prompt: A magnifying glass app using the camera with zoom up to 8x, pinch to zoom, freeze the picture to read it calmly, the camera light, and high contrast, inverted and yellow filters for reading.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Magic 8 Ball
apps.description: Ask a yes or no question, shake or tap the ball and read your answer.
apps.prompt: A realistic Magic 8 Ball: type a question, shake the phone or tap the ball, it shakes and the blue triangle floats up with one of the twenty classic answers.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Loan Calculator
apps.description: Work out the monthly payment of a mortgage, car or personal loan, with the full amortisation table.
apps.prompt: A loan calculator for mortgages, car loans and personal loans with sliders for amount, interest and years, the monthly payment, total interest, a chart of principal and interest per year and the amortisation table.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Kanban Board
apps.description: Organise anything in columns: drag cards from To do to Done, with colours and quick editing.
apps.prompt: A Kanban board with To do, Doing, Review and Done columns, colourful cards I can drag between columns and reorder, swipe between columns, and tap a card to edit, move or delete it.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Invoice Maker
apps.description: Create clean, professional invoices with items, tax and discount, ready to send or print.
apps.prompt: An invoice maker where I fill in my details, the client, invoice number and dates, items with quantity and price, tax and discount, and see a clean professional invoice I can print as PDF or share.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Hoop Shot 3D
apps.description: Swipe up to shoot hoops on a 3D court: real bounces off the rim, swishes, streaks and a moving hoop.
apps.prompt: A 3D basketball shooting game with three.js: swipe up to throw, ball physics that bounce off the rim and backboard, a wooden court and crowd lights, 60 seconds, extra points for swishes and streaks, and the hoop starts moving after 10 points.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Homework Helper
apps.description: Type an exercise or take a photo and your AI explains it step by step, gives you just a hint, or explains it like you're 10.
apps.prompt: A homework helper: type the exercise or take a photo of it, choose just a hint, step by step or explain like I am 10, and the AI answers with numbered steps revealed one at a time, the final answer and how to check it. Keep a list of recent questions.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Habit Streaks
apps.description: Tick off your habits every day, keep your streaks alive and see the last 12 weeks at a glance.
apps.prompt: A habit tracker where each habit has an emoji and colour, a row of the last seven days to tick, the current and best streak, and a 12 week heatmap of how many habits I completed each day.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Goals
apps.description: Break big goals into steps, tick them off and watch the progress ring fill up.
apps.prompt: A goals app where each goal has an emoji, an optional deadline with days left, a list of steps I add and tick off, a progress ring and a celebration when the goal is reached.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Freelance Rate
apps.description: Calculate the hourly rate you need as a freelancer after taxes, costs, holidays and unbillable time.
apps.prompt: A freelance rate calculator: the net income I want, taxes, monthly costs, a buffer, working hours, the share of billable hours, holidays and sick days, giving the minimum hourly and daily rate and where the money goes.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Fortune Cookie
apps.description: Crack open a cookie for a fortune and your lucky numbers.
apps.prompt: A fortune cookie app: tap the cookie, it shakes and cracks in two halves, a paper with a funny or wise fortune and six lucky numbers appears, with crunch sound and share button.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Focus Timer
apps.description: A Pomodoro timer with focus blocks, short and long breaks, weekly stats and a daily streak.
apps.prompt: A Pomodoro focus timer with a big progress ring, focus, short and long break modes with custom minutes, what I'm focusing on, a notification and sound at the end, a weekly chart of focus minutes and a streak.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Flashcards
apps.description: Make your own decks and study them with spaced repetition: the cards you find hard come back sooner.
apps.prompt: A flashcards app: create decks by writing one card per line as question = answer, flip cards to study, rate each one as again, hard, good or easy, and schedule reviews with spaced repetition. Show how many cards are due in each deck.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Expenses
apps.description: Track what you spend by category, with a monthly budget, a donut chart and the last six months.
apps.prompt: An expense tracker where I add expenses with a category and note, see the month total with a donut by category, a monthly budget bar, comparison with last month, a six month chart and expenses grouped by day.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Emoji Movies
apps.description: Guess the film from a few emoji, with hints and ten movies per round.
apps.prompt: A guess the movie from emoji quiz with forty famous films, four options, hints with the genre and year, ten movies per round and a best score.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Email Writer
apps.description: Write what you want to say in a few words and your AI turns it into a polished email.
apps.prompt: An email writing assistant: I type my idea in my own words, who it's for, the tone like professional, friendly or apologetic, and the length, and my AI writes the subject and the email, with copy, share and another version.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Decision Wheel
apps.description: Can't decide? Make your own wheels, add options and spin with ticking sounds.
apps.prompt: A spinning decision wheel with colourful slices, ticking sound, several saved wheels I can name, editable options and an option to remove the winner after each spin.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Debt Payoff
apps.description: Plan how to get out of debt: compare the snowball and avalanche methods and see your debt-free date.
apps.prompt: A debt payoff planner where I list debts with balance, interest and minimum payment, add an extra monthly amount, and it compares the snowball and avalanche methods with the debt-free date, interest paid and payoff order.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Date Calculator
apps.description: Days between two dates, adding days, weeks or working days to a date, and your exact age with your next birthday.
apps.prompt: A date calculator with three tabs: the days, weeks, working days and weekends between two dates; adding or subtracting days, weeks, months, years or working days from a date; and your exact age with the day you were born and your next birthday.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Daily Journal
apps.description: A cosy diary with a mood for each day, a question to get you writing and a 4 week overview.
apps.prompt: A daily journal on lined paper with a mood picker, a different writing prompt each day, word count, autosave, and a calendar of the last four weeks showing the mood of each day.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Currency Converter
apps.description: Convert between 30 currencies with today's European Central Bank rates, even offline.
apps.prompt: A currency converter using today's European Central Bank rates from Frankfurter, with flags, swap, the rate both ways, the amount in other common currencies and the last rates saved for when there's no internet.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Country Facts
apps.description: 73 countries with their flags and capitals, a summary of each from Wikipedia, and your own list of places visited and to visit.
apps.prompt: A country explorer with flags and capitals by continent, search, a random country button, a detail page with a Wikipedia summary, and buttons to mark countries as visited or want to go with counters.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Countdowns
apps.description: Count down the days, hours and minutes to holidays, birthdays and everything you look forward to.
apps.prompt: A countdown app for my upcoming events with emoji, colourful cards, days, hours, minutes and seconds ticking, and past events shown as time since.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Compound Interest
apps.description: See how your savings grow over the years with compound interest and monthly contributions.
apps.prompt: A compound interest calculator with an initial amount, monthly contributions, annual return, years and compounding frequency, showing the final amount, what I paid in and the interest, a stacked chart and milestones.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Charades
apps.description: Guess the word on your forehead before time runs out: animals, movies, actions, jobs and more.
apps.prompt: A Heads Up style charades game: the phone shows a word from a deck like animals, movies or jobs, friends give clues, a 30, 60 or 90 second timer, got it and pass buttons and a results list.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Capitals
apps.description: What's the capital of…? Rounds of 10 by continent with believable wrong answers, best scores and a list to review.
apps.prompt: A capitals quiz: choose a continent or the whole world, see a country with its flag and pick its capital among four options from the same region, with best scores per region and the ones you missed at the end.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Business Card
apps.description: Design a business card in four styles and colours, save it as an image or share your contact.
apps.prompt: A business card maker with my name, job title, company, phone, email and website, four templates like modern, classic, bold and minimal, colours, a flip animation, saving it as an image and sharing the contact.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Bubble Level
apps.description: A spirit level that uses your phone's sensors, with degrees, calibration and a buzz when it's level.
apps.prompt: A bubble level app with a green vial and a bubble that moves with the phone's tilt sensors, X and Y degrees, calibration, hold reading and a vibration when it is perfectly level.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Brick Breaker
apps.description: Smash neon bricks with a glowing paddle, catch power-ups and clear level after level.
apps.prompt: A brick breaker game with a paddle you drag, neon bricks in different patterns per level, bricks that need two hits, steel bricks, power-ups for a wider paddle, multi-ball, slow motion and extra lives.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Break-even
apps.description: Find out how many units you must sell each month to cover your costs, with a chart and a profit simulator.
apps.prompt: A break-even calculator for small businesses with fixed costs, selling price and cost per unit, the units needed to break even, a chart of revenue and costs, and a slider to see profit or loss for any sales volume.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Block Drop
apps.description: Classic falling blocks with a ghost piece, hold, next pieces and levels that speed up.
apps.prompt: A falling blocks puzzle game like Tetris with swipe and tap controls, ghost piece, hold, the next three pieces, levels that get faster and a saved best score.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Battery & Device
apps.description: Your battery level, charging state and temperature, plus details about your phone and screen.
apps.prompt: A battery and device info app showing the battery level in a big battery icon, charging status and temperature, device model and Android version, screen, network, language, time zone and storage, with tips to look after the battery.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.description: Swipe to slide the tiles and merge equal numbers until you reach 2048, with undo.
apps.prompt: The 2048 puzzle with smooth sliding tiles, swipe controls, undo, a best score and the game saved so I can continue later.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: 20 Questions
apps.description: Think of anything and your AI tries to guess it with yes or no questions.
apps.prompt: A 20 questions game where my AI asks me yes or no questions to guess what I'm thinking of, with categories like animals, famous people or food, and a score of AI against me.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Reef Aquarium
apps.description: A relaxing 3D reef: feed the fish and watch the jellyfish glow at night.
apps.prompt: A relaxing 3D aquarium: colorful fish swim in schools between swaying seaweed, coral and rocks, with rising bubbles and light rays from above. Tap the glass to drop food and the fish swim to eat it. Drag to rotate the camera.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Pocket Coach
apps.description: A workout coach that talks you through a 3-minute routine and vibrates on every change.
apps.prompt: A personal workout coach that talks: a 3-minute routine of exercises with a big animated countdown ring. The phone says each exercise out loud, counts down the last 3 seconds by voice, vibrates when switching and cheers you at the end. Energetic, modern design.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Pixel City
apps.description: Build an isometric pixel city with cars, people, a day and night cycle and fireworks.
apps.prompt: An isometric pixel art city builder: tap empty tiles to build houses, shops, parks and skyscrapers. Little cars drive on the roads and tiny people walk around. Money and population counters, and a day and night cycle where the windows light up at night. Cute and colorful.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Notes
apps.description: Notes with checklists, pinned notes, color labels and search.
apps.prompt: A professional notes app: write notes with a title and text, checklists, pin important notes, color labels and search, with a clean and elegant design.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Neon Kaleidoscope
apps.description: Draw with your finger and every stroke is mirrored eight ways in glowing neon.
apps.prompt: A neon kaleidoscope drawing app: draw with your finger and every stroke is mirrored in 8-way symmetry with glowing neon trails, sparkles and colors that slowly shift. Include an autoplay mode that draws by itself, and buttons to clear and change the symmetry.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Neon Drone Race
apps.description: A 3D race through glowing neon rings over a city at night, with rival drones.
apps.prompt: A 3D drone racing game: fly a drone through glowing neon rings over a futuristic city at night, with a lap timer, a boost button and an autopilot demo mode.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Piano
apps.description: Four instruments, multitouch keys and recordings you can play back.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Drummer
apps.description: Eight pads, a 16-step sequencer and saved beats.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Castle Defense
apps.description: Hold the castle against waves of enemies and bosses, with an upgrade shop.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Calculator
apps.description: A clean calculator with proper operator precedence and a saved history.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Bowling
apps.description: Swipe to throw, add hook spin and play a full game with real scoring.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: BMI
apps.description: Body mass index with a gauge, the healthy range and a progress chart.
apps.author: gonzaroman
